text: From the S4.3a review (blocks S4.2): (1) refAt(batchIndex) has no picker supplying a batch index. Intaglio NamedPicking treats a named point batch as one target, so either name each mark or build a routed InteractionPlan. See intaglio bd-01M3FJKMB1CKWYCY58AS6A2Y16, per-mark ids in batches. (2) Replace the hand-built casing batch with Intaglio 12a StrokeCasing so casing rings don't misresolve hits.
